entries.summary: Explicit public base paths for first setup, browser assets, API, CLI and MCP behind a path-preserving HTTPS proxy
Preserve exact Host/Origin, CSRF, bearer authentication and loopback-only listeners with prefixed routes
Retain configured public paths in self-update health probes and MCP deployment evidence
HTTPS proxy provisioning and cross-host relay remain external operator work; an unavailable Updater requires an independent human recovery channel

recovery_conditions: Preserve control journals, authentication and diagnostic evidence. Unknown effects stop without replay. When Updater is unavailable, use an independent administrator channel for human recovery; inspect queued Jobs before service restart.
